senses.gloss:
Vaikuṇṭha
(‘that which is without [or beyond] destruction’)
------------------------------------------
This word is used as one of the names of विष्णु and also of his abode or world.
Viṣṇu is called वैकुण्ठ since he is:
without or beyond destruction;
the ruler of jīvas (individual selves);
the giver of knowledge.
Vaikuṇṭha is more well-known in the epics and पुराणस् as the abode or world of विष्णु. This world is of infinite dimensions. The liberated souls, live there having a similar form as the Lord विष्णु. It is full of unimaginable wealth and splendour. Great beings like ब्रह्मा, sages like सनक and other perfected beings live there in eternal bliss under the loving care of विष्णु and लक्ष्मी, serving them with deep devotion. (vide Bhāgavata 3.15.14-25).
